fileApiSettings.fileInternalStructureNote:
These options define how files will be organized and saved inside the HotFolder. You can choose the structure that best fits your workflow:

HotFolder:// Files
All files are saved directly in the main HotFolder.
Use when simple, flat storage is enough.

HotFolder:// Customer Name / Files
A folder is created for each customer.
Files are saved inside the corresponding customer's folder.
Best if you want to separate files by customer only.

HotFolder:// Customer Name / Job Number / Files
Each customer has a folder.
Inside, a subfolder is created for every job number.
Organizes files by both customer and job.

HotFolder:// Customer Name / Order Number / Job Number / Files
Each customer has a folder.
Inside, subfolders are created for order numbers, and then for job numbers.
Ideal for detailed tracking (customer → order → job).

HotFolder:// Job Number / Files
A separate folder is created for each job number, directly in the HotFolder.
Useful when jobs are the main way you organize files.

HotFolder:// Order Number / Job Number / Files
A folder is created for each order number.
Inside, subfolders are created for job numbers.
Best when orders are more important than customers.
fileApiSettings.fileDeliveryModeNote:
Option 1 – Always Send
All files will always be saved to this HotFolder, regardless of product rules.
Use this if you want every file to go to the folder without conditions.

Option 2 – Rule-Based Send
Files will only be saved to this HotFolder if the product's "role" setting is marked as true.
Use this if you want the folder to receive files only for specific products, based on rules
